last_summary: The supported local progression is v3 (loose rice with separate salmon/wasabi) -> v1 (rice shaped into a ball while salmon remains separate) -> v2 (rice pressed onto salmon and a finished nigiri held) -> v4 (completed salmon-topped nigiri resting on the board with no active forming/pressing, plus a cloth being set down). R3 remains formally unresolved because v4's resting nigiri cannot be proven identical to v2's held piece, but with no visual calls remaining the best evidence-supported sequence is v3 -> v1 -> v2 -> v4.
review_reason: Newly observed v4 evidence directly settled the stated local goal by showing a completed salmon-topped nigiri resting next to an intact rice pile with no hands actively forming or pressing it.
